senses.gloss: חֵרֵר (denom. of חוֹר II) to set free.—Part. pass. מְחוֹרָר freed, free.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14">Gen. R. s. 14</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 2:7">Gen. II, 7</cite> <he>נפש חיה</he>) <he>עבד מח׳ בפני עצמו וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>מכודן</he>, v. <cite ref="K00142"><he>כָּדַן</he></cite>) a freed slave left to himself for a living.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 51b">Keth. 51ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 95a:13">B. Kam. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>המְחוֹרָרִין</he> (<cite ref="N00841"><he>נכסים</he></cite>) unencumbered property. [Shaf. <cite ref="U00720"><he>שִׁחֲרֵר</he></cite>.]
